content:
alex: Quick checkin — ran microbench with eviction heartbeat at 50ms, saw p99 spike at ~420ms for tiny requests.
maya: Can you paste the exact config and traffic shape?
alex: Config: `heartbeat_ms=50 prefetch=on headroom=0.2 slot_credits=10` Traffic: 90% tiny (<=32 tokens), 10% long tails.
cheng: That p99 seems high — is it correlated with batch cutover? Any KV cache churn logs?
alex: attaching logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-20T14:02:31Z eviction: triggered tenant=svc-12 reason=heartbeat
2026-03-20T14:02:31Z batch_cutover: microbatch=17 -> gpu_queue
2026-03-20T14:02:31Z kvcache: evict keys=312 resident=812
```
maya: We should simulate different heartbeat intervals + bursty arrival. Maybe heartbeat interacts poorly with prefetch handshake.
sam: Experiment idea: decouple eviction heartbeat from admission window — only signal if queue_length>threshold OR idle>timeout.
rachel: Agree. Also try `heartbeat_jitter` to avoid synchronized evictions across tenants.
cheng: Interface question: should the scheduler expose `lease_optional` on enqueue API so callers can opt-out of heartbeat reclaim?
alex: That would be a nice contract. But callers would need fallback if they opt out and memory/kv grows. Means runtime needs to track `opt_out` per-stream.
maya: Implementation boundary: leave opt-out flag on RequestEnvelope proto, scheduler treats false as default; runtime validates total headroom.
sam: Telemetry: add `eviction_reason` tag (heartbeat|memory|idle|preempt) and `heartbeat_interval_ms` in span.
alex: Also add synthetic load generator to run microbursts (10-50reqs in 50ms) with variable seq lengths — we can run in perf infra.
cheng: I'd like to see a short-term mitigation: increase heartbeat from 50->150ms and add jitter +/-50ms. Should lower p99 tail.
rachel: ok let's run 3 experiments: baseline(50ms), jittered(150±50ms), opt_out-path test. I'll coordinate perf runs.
maya: thanks — ping me when results ready, will draft followup RFC if stable. :thumbsup:
